title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Training Note: Tenure Relief on a Catch-Up Payment
content:
*Training note, financing care desk.*

**The rule.** The borrower's tenure gives the tenure relief share on a catch-up payment for a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan): payments covered reaching the long-tenure count of 36 take the long-tenure relief share of 10%; payments covered reaching the mid-tenure count of 24 but not the long-tenure count take the mid-tenure relief share of 5%; fewer take none.

Part of the fee pool, being the late fees, returned-payment fees and phone payment fees posted in the three months before the payment less the fee reversals posted in those months (a pool below zero counts as zero), is left on the balance instead of being collected in the catch-up payment. Where more than one relief share applies to the same catch-up payment, the shares are added together; the relief is the combined share times the fee pool, rounded to the cent and never more than the fee pool, and the catch-up payment is the catch-up figure less the relief, rounded to the cent and never below zero. Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

**Q. What are payments covered?**
A. The scheduled-payment entries less the returned payments, divided by the scheduled monthly payment and rounded down to a whole number. The scheduled monthly payment is the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 applied to the financed amount, rounded to the cent and at least the plan's minimum monthly payment.

**Q. Which share at which count?**

| Payments covered | Tenure relief share |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 10% |
| 24 to 35 | 5% |
| 23 or fewer | None |

**Q. And on the lines?** 36 takes 10%, 35 takes 5%; 24 takes 5%, 23 takes none.

**Q. Hypothetical example.** 40 payments covered, fee pool 58.00, no other relief share: relief 10% of 58.00, 5.80.
